question: Estimate the annual toothpaste consumption in India (by tube count and tonnage).
idealClarificationQuestions: Total tubes sold per year? Yes — across all brands and pack sizes.
Includes both salt-based (HUL Pepsodent), herbal (Patanjali, Dabur Red), and premium (Sensodyne)? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Population × penetration × usage frequency × tube life.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Average per-person toothpaste consumption: ~150 g/year (urban higher ~200g; rural ~100g).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Average tube size: ~100 g (range: 50g travel to 200g family pack; weighted ~100g).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Tubes sold annually: 185,000,000 kg / 0.1 kg = ~1.85 billion tubes.

benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~100 g (range: 50g travel to 200g family pack; weighted ~100g).

calculationFlow: Toothpaste-using population (excluding kids under 3 + non-users using tooth powder/manjan): ~85% = 1.23B.
Total toothpaste consumed: 1.23B × 150g = ~185,000 tonnes per year.
Tubes sold annually: 185,000,000 kg / 0.1 kg = ~1.85 billion tubes.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: Tubes sold annually: 185,000,000 kg / 0.1 kg = ~1.85 billion tubes.
